issues.body:
## Why

C269 left H22.02 partial because the retained controls did not isolate removal of the actual source import digest. This candidate adds that missing finite evidence under the unchanged C260 contract.

## What changes

An independent author froze two historical baselines and four exact digest-deletion inputs before execution. A bounded runner checks source observation, input binding and hinge comparison, retaining complete inputs, responses, identities and assertions. New C271 task and handoff records keep the parent open.

No observer/runtime, grammar, contract, dependency pin, existing control or historical evidence changes. CURRENT on this branch identifies the proposed active task; main remains unchanged until a later reviewed integration.

## Evidence

Executed on clean code/oracle commit `067392f2b5f592a5c3104fa8848cc0030ba1117b`, tree `21ab07914931495d6bee70591a70ff2d8bcabb84`, CPython 3.12.14/Linux x86-64:

- Six input cases, 18 interface calls: six baseline successes and twelve exact `MALFORMED` refusals.
- 1,042 assertions passed; zero failures. Input hashes and refusal reasons propagate without a qualified partial result.
- Full evidence is preserved in `docs/engineering/localized-repair-c271/evidence/control-candidate/`.
- Independent review passed 425 candidate checks, 30 publication checks and 58 final-source checks. Its exact-command provenance finding was resolved without changing the original evidence.
- Workflow/documentation checks passed on the clean packaged source and again on the clean receipt-only publication `88bc8b51b3963b7072375edac6400b6e6a4532e4`.
- Independent archive audit passed 1,934 checks after preserving and resolving three checker assumptions; package bytes remained unchanged.

## Phase boundary and remaining gates

C271 P01 is complete as a partial delivery. Early recovery was confirmed before control construction. The verified ZIP and both matching prompts are saved; the separate receipt and P01-only state closure are published. This remains a draft, unmerged candidate. P02 belongs to a fresh parent chat.

Saved [P01 handoff](https://chatgpt.com/library?file_id=libfile_fde3_f-6fa4862a8b2c8191957e4b0760c32705_2ab2a24d43748191957f9bcc356b59de&account_id=personal); [separate delivery receipt](https://github.com/Omegapy/OntoKin/blob/88bc8b51b3963b7072375edac6400b6e6a4532e4/docs/engineering/localized-repair-c271/delivery/P01-DELIVERY.json). Frozen source: `e0b73f7d6ce49631e598d1378a0ddba717726524`. ZIP: 12,003,931 bytes; SHA-256 `9bdb8ec134fbf8facc1b1f52aa9b7171de16f35593ddf7ad61930e521f4495df`. The later receipt-only commit stays outside the declared ZIP freeze boundary.

P02 retains the required routine local driver, complete affected regression cohort, independent integration approval, expected-head integration ownership, actual-main verification, branch lifecycle and final saved delivery. Parent and scope issue stay open. No complete H22/C260/product qualification follows.

Tracks #273. Director: `c271-control-cce28e2b3ca4`. No main integration lease or hosted CI requested.
